VoiceCommand.title: VoiceCommand
VoiceCommand.description: Represents a voice command received from the user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the voice command.

userId.description: Reference to the User who issued the command. (Relationship: User 1:N VoiceCommand)

commandText.description: The raw text of the voice command as transcribed.

interpretedText.description: The interpreted text of the command after AI processing.

timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the voice command was received.

CommandExecution.title: CommandExecution
CommandExecution.description: Represents the execution of a command in Termux.

id.description: Unique identifier for the command execution.

voiceCommandId.description: Reference to the VoiceCommand that triggered this execution. (Relationship: VoiceCommand 1:N CommandExecution)

command.description: The actual command executed in Termux.

startTime.description: Timestamp indicating when the command execution started.

endTime.description: Timestamp indicating when the command execution ended.

output.description: The output (stdout and stderr) of the command execution.

Installation.title: Installation
Installation.description: Represents an installation managed by the tool.

voiceCommandId.description: Reference to the VoiceCommand that triggered this installation. (Relationship: VoiceCommand 1:N Installation)

name.description: Name of the application, repo, or update being installed.

startTime.description: Timestamp indicating when the installation started.

endTime.description: Timestamp indicating when the installation ended.

CodeModification.title: CodeModification
CodeModification.description: Represents a code modification suggested and applied by the tool.

id.description: Unique identifier for the code modification.

voiceCommandId.description: Reference to the VoiceCommand that triggered this modification. (Relationship: VoiceCommand 1:N CodeModification)

filePath.description: Path to the file being modified.

modifiedCode.description: The modified code after applying the suggestion.

timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the code modification was applied.

GitHubRepo.title: GitHubRepo
GitHubRepo.description: Represents a GitHub repository used for pulling scripts/programs.

id.description: Unique identifier for the GitHub repository.

voiceCommandId.description: Reference to the VoiceCommand that requested this integration. (Relationship: VoiceCommand 1:N GitHubRepo)

lastPulledCommit.description: The last commit that was successfully pulled.

lastPulledDate.description: Timestamp indicating when the repo was last pulled.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the TermAI application.

email.description: The email address of the user.

registrationDate.description: Timestamp indicating when the user registered.

RootAccessRequest.title: RootAccessRequest
RootAccessRequest.description: Represents a request for root access by the AI.

id.description: Unique identifier for the root access request.

voiceCommandId.description: Reference to the VoiceCommand that triggered this request. (Relationship: VoiceCommand 1:N RootAccessRequest)

requestedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the root access was requested.

granted.description: Indicates whether root access was granted.

grantedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when root access was granted (if applicable).

AIResponse.title: AIResponse
AIResponse.description: Represents an AI generated response or suggestion.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AI response.

voiceCommandId.description: Reference to the VoiceCommand for this Response. (Relationship: VoiceCommand 1:N AIResponse)

responseText.description: The text of the AI response.

timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the AI response was generated.

id.description: Unique identifier for the error log entry.

voiceCommandId.description: Reference to the VoiceCommand for this Error. (Relationship: VoiceCommand 1:N ErrorLog)

timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the error occurred.

sourceFile.description: Source file where the error occurred.

lineNumber.description: Line number in the source file where the error occurred.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to securely manage data for the TermAI application, focusing on voice commands and their related processes. It prioritizes authorization independence by denormalizing user IDs to avoid using `get()` calls in security rules. The structure facilitates secure `list` operations by segregating data based on ownership. The design implements path-based ownership where appropriate and membership maps where shared access is required.

Each top-level entity related to a user is organized under the `/users/{userId}` collection, ensuring clear ownership and easy implementation of security rules. All subcollections under the `/users/{userId}` path inherit the user's ownership. This approach provides a simple and robust way to manage data associated with each user.

For entities directly related to voice commands, such as installations, AI responses, error logs, code modifications, command executions, GitHub repos, and root access requests, a nested structure under `/users/{userId}/voiceCommands/{voiceCommandId}` is utilized. This structure provides a clear hierarchy and improves data organization, making it easier to query and manage related data. This also makes the relationship between voice commands and sub-entities explicit, as shown in the schema, which allows for more intuitive debugging.

This structure supports the application's core features by providing a scalable and secure way to store and manage data. The explicit ownership and clear relationships between entities simplify the implementation of security rules, ensuring that only authorized users can access specific data. Also this explicit structure makes it easy to address edge-cases during implementation that may not be obvious at implementation time.
